description: This file defines and exports a single function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes an array of cost records, organizing and aggregating them into a dataset suitable for creating stacked series charts with zero-filled stacks for visualization, primarily using Recharts.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost aggregate records into a Recharts-friendly dataset, organizing by specified categories and optionally sorting, with zero-filling for missing categories.
